title: OPTIMAL INVESTMENT STRATEGIES FOR CONTROLLING DRAWDOWNS
idea: Scale daily exposure to Nasdaq futures (or QQQ) in proportion to the surplus (current equity curve minus α times its running maximum). Set α≈0.8 and exposure = k·(W‑αM)/W, with k calibrated to target a given volatility.
